verdict.rationale: telli documents its own agent builder with a Test call dialog, custom voices via voice cloning, phone numbers through forwarding to a telli number or SIP-trunk import, and Charlie to help build agents. Together these cover the voice, number, and test-call parts of the story. However, prompt authoring is not explicitly documented, and nothing shows a quick path to a first live call; number setup depends on SIP trunk access or PBX forwarding configuration. missing for 10: explicit prompt/instructions configuration docs, evidence of self-serve number provisioning, evidence of time-to-first-live-call within an hour, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: In the agent builder, click Test call to open the dialog.
Voice cloning lets you give your agent a custom voice
Keep your public business number and forward incoming calls to a telli number.
Connect an existing number and phone system for incoming and outgoing calls. You need SIP trunk access from your provider.
Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.
